subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

CAPSULE : PACSELU :: PINDROP : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and third letters are interchanged with each other.
 
• Fifth and seventh letters are interchanged with each other.
 
• Rest letters are written as it at same position .

​So,

 
• CAPSULE : PACSELU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a4896a8a67ae87607092f8c749eafdcbfd9e5c9c9a098ab8b5d56404cc5a8b7.png] ​

​Similarly,

 
• PINDROP : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a688924da5fc29c7d6514cc10d1e52af51008f262c33074cfb0fe7f1922a2e3.png] 

Hence, **"****NIPDPOR"** is the correct answer.

ba:T
